entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You leaned over the balcony railing..."
entries.dialogueText:
You leaned over the balcony railing. Your knees felt weak.

'Was this it?', you asked. 'Was this the end of my reign?'. With these words in your mind, gone were the days of Romus the First.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...were furious with anger."
entries.dialogueText: ...were furious with anger.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt relieved from the burden."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt relieved from the burden.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt lucky that you didn't die."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt lucky that you didn't die.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "People were cheering with a magnitu..."
entries.dialogueText:
People were cheering with a magnitude you had never seen before. They threw down their weapons and hugged each other.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...promised that you would get your..."
entries.dialogueText: ...promised that you would get your revenge one day.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...thought that perhaps this was th..."
entries.dialogueText: ...thought that perhaps this was the best possible outcome.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wondered how your days would be..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wondered how your days would be from now on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizian flag atop the palace unf..."
entries.dialogueText:
The Rizian flag atop the palace unfurled strongly with the wind.

You thought that it was...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the most beautiful thing you eve..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the most beautiful thing you ever saw.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...not worth dying for."
entries.dialogueText: ...not worth dying for.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...just a piece of cloth."
entries.dialogueText: ...just a piece of cloth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Releasing the reins of power had be..."
entries.dialogueText:
Releasing the reins of power had been a challenge, both for you and for the nation. Yet, it was a threshold crossed, a door shut behind you. 

As one chapter ended, another began – not just for you, but for Rizia too. In the weeks that followed, the kingdom felt reborn, marked by new leadership and new attitudes. 

You felt...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Then democracy arrived in the kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: Then democracy arrived in the kingdom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Power had been a fragile thing, bes..."
entries.dialogueText:
Power had been a fragile thing, bestowed and then forcibly taken away. In the Citadel, days had turned into weeks. 

The same walls that had once confined many during your reign now held you captive.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...found bitter irony in this cruel..."
entries.dialogueText: ...found bitter irony in this cruel twist of fate.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina wasted no time visiting. She r..."
entries.dialogueText:
Vina wasted no time visiting. She recounted how she and Axel had spent the days following the coup with their ears glued to the radio, anxiously waiting for news of your survival.

Now that you were free, she asked you to join her and her husband in Pales, away from the influence of the noble houses.

You decided...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to accept her offer and move to..."
entries.dialogueText: ...to accept her offer and move to the province.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to remain in Rizia, requesting f..."
entries.dialogueText: ...to remain in Rizia, requesting for her to visit you soon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You, your mother and Lucita were gi..."
entries.dialogueText:
You, your mother and Lucita were given an exquisitely lavish set of rooms at the castle with Axel, Vina and the rest of the royal household.

It felt like the luxury of the old days, and spending time around Vina felt good. 

Axel came to you to ask for a favor. Your presence was requested at a party where Arcasian diplomats would be in attendance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You accepted."
entries.dialogueText: You accepted.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You rejected."
entries.dialogueText: You rejected.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...you didn't want family tying you..."
entries.dialogueText: ...you didn't want family tying you down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ambassador Nicolas Rembrandteur..."
entries.dialogueText:
The ambassador Nicolas Rembrandteur and the Foreign Minister Louis Martell were present at the evening.

Axel introduced them to you and you charmed them with your...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of King Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of King Hugo Toras, your life shall be spared, your honor reinstated, and your family granted clemency.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "At least you fought for something g..."
entries.dialogueText: At least you fought for something greater, for a better world.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You couldn't help but wish you had..."
entries.dialogueText: You couldn't help but wish you had crushed your enemies when you had the chance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumors seeped through the prison wa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumors seeped through the prison walls. The coupists had crushed Rizia's nascent democracy. 

The reform movement, once a beacon of hope, had become nothing but a stillborn dream.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The world outside had shifted and m..."
entries.dialogueText:
The world outside had shifted and morphed, yet in many ways, it had remained achingly the same. 

Your release came as part of the Sovereign Transition and Clemency Act signed by the new monarch of Rizia.

On your way out you were handed a letter that read...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt nothing but the weight of t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt nothing but the weight of time, indifferent and patient.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...counted each day, a silent rebel..."
entries.dialogueText: ...counted each day, a silent rebellion against your fate.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It seemed pointless now, worrying a..."
entries.dialogueText: It seemed pointless now, worrying about what could have been.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...under the royal decree of King R..."
entries.dialogueText: ...under the royal decree of King Rico Toras, your life is hereby preserved, your honor reclaimed, and the safety of your family assured.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...through the royal decree of King..."
entries.dialogueText: ...through the royal decree of King Taddeus Azaro, your life is spared, your honor restored, and your family's sanctity upheld.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of Queen Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of Queen Lucita Azaro, your life is spared, your honor redeemed, and your family's well-being guaranteed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...by the royal decree of Queen Ang..."
entries.dialogueText: ...by the royal decree of Queen Angelica Sazon, your existence is spared, your honor renewed, and your family's safety preserved.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Stepping out of the Citadel, the si..."
entries.dialogueText:
Stepping out of the Citadel, the sight of new monuments and currency greeted you, your once-familiar kingly face absent from it all. 

Beyond the prison gates, there awaited your beloved...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Settling into Estela's guest house..."
entries.dialogueText:
Settling into Estela's guest house in Porte Drazon for a few days provided a needed respite to gather your thoughts. 

Leafing through a newspaper, you discovered the war at the southern border with the Grand Duchy was still unrelenting.

It was a moment to ponder your next steps. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taking refuge in your mother's gues..."
entries.dialogueText:
Taking refuge in your mother's guest house in Porte Drazon, you allowed yourself a few days to reorient.

A glance at the newspaper revealed upcoming celebrations and festivities across Rizia, marking a time of national joy. 

It was a moment to ponder your next steps. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To circumvent any potential for pol..."
entries.dialogueText:
To circumvent any potential for political unrest in the capital, Queen Lucita moved your imprisonment to Iza, far from Porte Drazon. 

You were relocated to a slightly better jail cell with a view of the city skyline.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...moved to Iza for a taste of city..."
entries.dialogueText: ...moved to Iza for a taste of city life.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...moved to a hut in Zpana's nature..."
entries.dialogueText: ...moved to a hut in Zpana's nature.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ".....settled seaside in Topes, near..."
entries.dialogueText: .....settled seaside in Topes, near the ancient Rezenid sites.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You would never again wear the crow..."
entries.dialogueText: You would never again wear the crown. But for the first time since your birth, choosing your destiny was truly in your hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina wasted no time visiting. Life..."
entries.dialogueText:
Vina wasted no time visiting. Life in Pales with Axel was flourishing, she said. She extended an invitation to join them and start anew together. 

You decided...

At 11:13 AM, your son opened his eyes to his first morning. In that instant...

entries.dialogueText:
Life with Pabel was fulfilling, despite the occasional odd looks from locals. When you were together, everything else seemed trivial. 

In this newfound contentment, you spent more time...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the joy of parenthood eclipsed a..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the joy of parenthood eclipsed all else.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...everything else faded, only this..."
entries.dialogueText: ...everything else faded, only this moment mattered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: ...all of life's complexities seemed trivial.

entries.title: Narrator: "A year later, Vina and Axel visited..."
entries.dialogueText:
A year later, Vina and Axel visited, bringing a delightful surprise – their baby daughter Lena, named after her grandmother.

In that moment of familial joy, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's whereabouts remained a myste..."
entries.dialogueText:
Vina's whereabouts remained a mystery.

You wondered if you would ever see or hear from your daughter again.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You decided to explore the city of..."
entries.dialogueText: You decided to explore the city of Pales instead. You had never truly gotten to know it before. Now, you...

entries.title: Player_Romus: "..legendary humor, regaling them wi..."

entries.title: Player_Romus: "...outlandish tales from your Party..."
entries.dialogueText: ...outlandish tales from your Party Prince days.

entries.dialogueText: ...deep philosophical musings.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..enjoyed the beach scene, mingling..."
entries.dialogueText: ..enjoyed the beach scene, mingling incognito with locals and tourists.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...went out on the town, hunting fo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...went out on the town, hunting for the best restaurants and bars.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText:
Months passed in Pales, and the Grand Duchy, under Vina and Axel's stewardship, flourished. 

Their happiness grew with the arrival of their baby daughter Lena, named after her grandmother. When Vina asked for your help in caring for her new child, it prompted a moment of reflection. 

You realized...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...you wanted nothing more than to..."
entries.dialogueText: ...you wanted nothing more than to be a caring grandfather.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..wandered the historic streets, ab..."
entries.dialogueText: ..wandered the historic streets, absorbing the city's heritage.

You...

entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wrote him a letter of congratula..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wrote him a letter of congratulations.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wished for more radical change."
entries.dialogueText: ...wished for more radical change.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over time, the security threats dim..."
entries.dialogueText:
Over time, the security threats diminished, granting you the freedom you'd longed for. 

You rekindled your bonds with friends and acquaintances you hadn't seen since taking the throne.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A chilling announcement halted the..."
entries.dialogueText:
A chilling announcement halted the continent: a devastating nuclear exchange had ravaged Holsord and parts of Rumburg.

The AN's swift intervention brought a respite from the hostilities within 72 hours, though conventional conflicts in East Merkopa escalated.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An alarming broadcast interrupted y..."
entries.dialogueText:
An alarming broadcast interrupted your day: Rumburg was under invasion by the Republic of Sordland. 

The toll was already steep, with no end in sight. While Rumburg was distant, the war's impact was felt in Rizia, where Rumburgian refugees were reluctant to return to their ravaged homeland.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a sense of relief wash over you."
entries.dialogueText: ...a sense of relief wash over you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...hopeful about the future unfoldi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...hopeful about the future unfolding.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a pang of regret for your past r..."
entries.dialogueText: ...a pang of regret for your past reign's shortcomings.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Queen Vina quickly endeared herself..."
entries.dialogueText:
Queen Vina quickly endeared herself to the populace, earning the affectionate title of 'People's Queen.' 

Shortly after her coronation, she initiated a sweeping campaign to eradicate poverty that proved both popular and effective. 

In her speeches, she gratefully acknowledged your contributions to the nation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "King Hugo garnered respect from old..."
entries.dialogueText:
King Hugo garnered respect from older citizens, who hailed him as 'The Protector King.' 

In his coronation address, he championed education and traditional values while paying homage to your legacy with respect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "King Rico Toras infused a newfound..."
entries.dialogueText:
King Rico Toras infused a newfound sense of nationalism and monarchism in Rizia. 

His first decree incorporated Su Omina into Rizia's national security forces.

Notably, he made no mention of you in his coronation address.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ascending monarch Hubertus Toras fa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Ascending monarch Hubertus Toras faced skepticism beyond Valenqiris, evidenced by the subdued response to his coronation. 

His first decree focused on boosting tourism with an amusement park in Valenqir. 

During his first address, he devoted a considerable time to lauding your tenure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Lucita Azaro ascended the throne..."
entries.dialogueText:
As Lucita Azaro ascended the throne as interim queen, you stood by her side as King Consort. Her popularity extended beyond Cardesse-Montaklar, overshadowing even your own legacy. 

In her first address, she acknowledged your past contributions with graciousness.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Long live the new Queen."
entries.dialogueText: Long live the new Queen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Long live the new King."
entries.dialogueText: Long live the new King.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...let the Palace staff do most of..."
entries.dialogueText: ...let the Palace staff do most of the work.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over time, the security threats dim..."
entries.dialogueText:
Over time, the security threats diminished, granting you the freedom you'd longed for. 

You immediately sought out Pabel. At long last, the two of you could be together without fear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt a twinge of obsolescence."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt a twinge of obsolescence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt reassured by her approach t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt reassured by her approach to maintain unity.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...immersing yourself in study and..."
entries.dialogueText: ...immersing yourself in study and knowledge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Queen Lucita Azaro arranged for you..."
entries.dialogueText:
Queen Lucita Azaro arranged for your transfer to Palas Rezna, reflecting the country's return to tranquility and a smoother-than-anticipated transition. 

In the grandeur of the palace, you spent your days...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But the serenity of your new life d..."
entries.dialogueText: But the serenity of your new life didn't last long. You were in your study when you received the news.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Vina was expecting a child."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was expecting a child.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tending to the gardens."
entries.dialogueText: ...tending to the gardens.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...aiding her in state matters as K..."
entries.dialogueText: ...aiding her in state matters as King Consort.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Lucita was in labor."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was in labor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The birth of Queen Lucita's son {Ri..."
entries.dialogueText:
The birth of Queen Lucita's son {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} sparked jubilation throughout the kingdom.

As a father for the second time, you...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...assumed childrearing duties whil..."
entries.dialogueText: ...assumed childrearing duties while your wife held the throne.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "A few weeks passed."
entries.dialogueText: A few weeks passed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Then democracy arrived in the kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: Then democracy arrived in the kingdom.

entries.dialogueText:
The news of your grandchild-to-be -- and the new heir to the Palesian throne -- filled you with joy.

Axel and Vina's visit to Palas Rezna was a time of celebration, a gathering of generations. 

Then, just a week later, the Queen herself went into labor.

entries.dialogueText: ...decided to try your hand at stand-up comedy.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Relaxed and enjoyed your new downti..."
entries.dialogueText: Relaxed and enjoyed your new downtime.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Relaxed and made new friends."

You...

entries.title: Narrator: "Your mother, open to a change of sc..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your mother, open to a change of scenery, relocated along with you.

You...

Pabel was excited to move to the Brenas capital. Since homosexuality was decriminalized, nightlife in the cultural hub was more thrilling than ever.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: ...you could balance your time between helping with Lena and pursuing your own interests.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...guiding Lena's early years could..."
entries.dialogueText: ...guiding Lena's early years could become a significant part of your legacy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Embracing grandfatherhood, you spen..."
entries.dialogueText:
Embracing grandfatherhood, you spent countless hours with Lena, witnessing her first steps, her first words. 

The bond you formed with her was irreplaceable, enriching your days with joy and laughter. 

As Lena grew, so did your role in her life.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You congratulated your daughter and..."
entries.dialogueText:
You congratulated your daughter and her husband on their new child, but told them you couldn't be counted on to help out.

You spent the rest of your days pursuing your own interests, traveling the world and telling anyone who'd listen about the brief time you spent as King of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You became a guiding presence in Le..."
entries.dialogueText:
You became a guiding presence in Lena's life while not forgoing your interests. 

The arrangement brought depth to your days, blending family warmth with personal growth. 

As Lena grew older, your relationship evolved. The title of "King Romus" faded from your memory, replaced by the name "Grandfather".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In grandfatherhood, you found a sen..."
entries.dialogueText:
In grandfatherhood, you found a sense of purpose. Your wisdom and experiences became the bedrock of her upbringing. 

As she grew, so did the impact of your teachings.

The path ahead gleamed with the promise of her blossoming under your tutelage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And thus your story ended."
entries.dialogueText: And thus your story ended.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your mother, feeling homesick, told..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your mother, feeling homesick, told you she wanted to spend her last years at her old house in Zille.

You saw her off, promising to visit as often as you could.

Your focus turned to...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...immersing yourself in the local..."
entries.dialogueText: ...immersing yourself in the local culture.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...pursuing hobbies and self-growth..."
entries.dialogueText: ...pursuing hobbies and self-growth.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...partaking in community social wo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...partaking in community social work.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...guided your granddaughter and ne..."
entries.dialogueText: ...guided your granddaughter and new son with wisdom and care.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...dedicated yourself to raising yo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...dedicated yourself to raising your son wisely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...balanced your grandfatherly duti..."
entries.dialogueText: ...balanced your grandfatherly duties with personal time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the psychology of warfare."
entries.dialogueText: ...the psychology of warfare.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As you flipped through the typewrit..."
entries.dialogueText:
As you flipped through the typewritten pages, a spark reignited within you for politics. 

Motivated, you resolved to pen your own thesis, asking your old university professors for guidance.

As a scholar, you focused on...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the influence of the spiritual w..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the influence of the spiritual will in human societies.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the wealth disparities in Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the wealth disparities in Rizia and the societal issues that arose from them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over the years, your societal promi..."
entries.dialogueText:
Over the years, your societal prominence waned. The eight years you spent as king faded in your memory, crowded out by your many other life experiences. 

During a quiet day at home, you picked up...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the teachings of Prophet Hu, the..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the teachings of Prophet Hu, the founder of Zaranism.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...Miraclism theories and the princ..."
entries.dialogueText: ...Miraclism theories and the principles of conservatism.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...totalism and the concept of enfo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...totalism and the concept of enforced efficient change.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Though your paper resonated with th..."
entries.dialogueText:
Though your paper resonated with those who knew you best, it received a lukewarm reception from academic circles. 

For you, at least, the endeavor marked a new, more thoughtful chapter in your life.

Those around you began referring to you affectionately as 'the Professor King'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Time unfolded as you pursued this n..."
entries.dialogueText:
Time unfolded as you pursued this newfound passion for knowledge. 

Your intellectual exploration defined your later years, earning you the moniker 'the philosopher king'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As time marched on, you aged with t..."
entries.dialogueText:
As time marched on, you aged with the wisdom and contentment your choices brought. 

Throughout the years, the name 'Romus Toras' was spoken with fondness and respect by those you cared about.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It had a nice ring to it."
entries.dialogueText: It had a nice ring to it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And there was finally peace."
entries.dialogueText: And there was finally peace.

entries.dialogueText:
At long last, Rumburg and Sordland reached a ceasefire, leading to a lasting peace. 

The years had seen much loss, often for reasons that now seemed trivial. But the burden of these events was no longer yours to bear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "War, war never changes."
entries.dialogueText: War, war never changes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You worried about the future."
entries.dialogueText: You worried about the future.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It felt good to be off the hook."
entries.dialogueText: It felt good to be off the hook.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a history book from your father'..."
entries.dialogueText: ...a history book from your father's old collection.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Engrossed, you delved into..."
entries.dialogueText: Engrossed, you delved into...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...a political thesis a friend had..."
entries.dialogueText: ...a political thesis a friend had entrusted you to review.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the immediatist movement, studyi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the immediatist movement, studying their drive for swift change.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the healing effects of humor in..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the healing effects of humor in society.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Under Sotelato’s leadership, the re..."
entries.dialogueText:
Under Sotelato’s leadership, the revolutionary government solidified, elevating him to a Prime Minister with tangible authority. 

Despite his ascendancy, factions were getting more extreme.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Purges against the nobility began."
entries.dialogueText: Purges against the nobility began.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Then, a loud bang."
entries.dialogueText: Then, a loud bang.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You decamped to one of your family..."
entries.dialogueText:
You decamped to one of your family guest houses near Porte Drazon.

After a few weeks in isolation, you couldn't take it anymore. You put on a disguise and went into the Old Town to get some air.

Suddenly, out of nowhere, you heard a shout. "YOU MONSTER! YOU TOOK HER AWAY FROM ME!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You took her advice."
entries.dialogueText: You took her advice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "In spite of her warnings, you chose..."
entries.dialogueText: In spite of her warnings, you chose to stay.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Lucita Azaro ascended the throne..."
entries.dialogueText:
As Lucita Azaro ascended the throne as interim queen, you stood by her side as King Consort. 

In her first address, she acknowledged your past contributions with graciousness.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ascending monarch Hubertus Toras fa..."
entries.dialogueText:
Ascending monarch Hubertus Toras faced skepticism beyond Valenqiris, evidenced by the subdued response to his coronation. 

During his first address, he devoted a considerable time to lauding your tenure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "King Rico Toras infused a newfound..."
entries.dialogueText:
King Rico Toras infused a newfound sense of nationalism and monarchism in Rizia. 

Notably, he made no mention of you in his coronation address.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You watched your successor's crowni..."
entries.dialogueText:
You watched your successor's crowning from seclusion. Death threats had begun arriving shortly after your abdication, and security advised you to keep a low profile.

You and your mother absconded to a family estate on the outskirts of Porte Drazon, waiting for the news that you were safe at last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Manus visited Palas Rezna t..."
entries.dialogueText:
She and Manus visited Palas Rezna to celebrate. It was a time of joy, a gathering of generations.

Then, just a week later, the Queen herself went into labor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried not to make the same mista..."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried not to make the same mistakes you did with Vina.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You lived out the rest of your days..."
entries.dialogueText:
You lived out the rest of your days as King Emeritus of Rizia, commanding respect but little authority.

The day your son came of age, the golden Toras crown was placed upon his head.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did not envy him."
entries.dialogueText: ...did not envy him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wished him the best of luck."
entries.dialogueText: ...wished him the best of luck.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...were reassured by the knowledge..."
entries.dialogueText: ...were reassured by the knowledge that the reign of House Toras would continue -- with or without you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You decamped to one of your family..."
entries.dialogueText: You decamped to one of your family guest houses near Porte Drazon and waited for the air to clear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Days passed in uncertainty."
entries.dialogueText: Days passed in uncertainty.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...your heartache from Vina's death..."
entries.dialogueText: ...your heartache from Vina's death diminished, though it never truly went away.

entries.dialogueText:

After a year or so, she had tracked down Manus Sazon. The two of them now had a daughter, named after her late grandmother Lena.

She wished you the best.

You...

Motivated, you resolved to pen your own thesis, asking the professors at Romus Toras University for guidance.

As a scholar, you focused on...

entries.title: Narrator: "After the war ended, she had finall..."
entries.dialogueText:
After the war ended, she had finally been allowed to leave Pales. 

She was on her way back to Rizia.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...welcomed her with open arms."
entries.dialogueText: ...welcomed her with open arms.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...urged her to go elsewhere, knowi..."
entries.dialogueText: ...urged her to go elsewhere, knowing she'd never truly be safe at home.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...apologized for the way everythin..."
entries.dialogueText: ...apologized for the way everything had turned out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...never answered."
entries.dialogueText: ...never answered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wrote back, apologizing for ever..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wrote back, apologizing for everything you'd put her through.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...burned the letter, knowing your..."
entries.dialogueText: ...burned the letter, knowing your daughter's family would be safer that way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With stiff formality, she informed..."
entries.dialogueText:
With stiff formality, she informed you she had been living in Kyrute under an assumed name.

She had married a commoner who knew nothing of her royal identity. The two of them now had a daughter, named after her late grandmother Lena. 

She wished you the best.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In it, your daughter expressed her..."
entries.dialogueText:
In it, your daughter expressed her gratitude for the way you had raised her.

She enclosed an old drawing she'd made as a child: you, her and Lena, with big golden crowns on your heads.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You had it framed."
entries.dialogueText: You had it framed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You couldn't bear to look at it."
entries.dialogueText: You couldn't bear to look at it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Eventually, you and Vina struck up..."
entries.dialogueText:
Eventually, you and Vina struck up a correspondence. You felt sorrow for all the years you'd missed, but gratitude that your daughter was back in your life.

As time marched on, you aged with the wisdom and contentment your choices brought.

You decided...

As you stepped beyond the prison gates, there awaited...

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "In spite of her warnings, you chose..."
entries.dialogueText: In spite of her warnings, you chose to stay.

You decamped to one of your family guest houses near Porte Drazon.

After a few weeks in isolation, you couldn't take it anymore. You put on a disguise and went into the Old Town to get some air.

Suddenly, out of nowhere, you heard a shout: "We finally found you!"

You...
